itemWeight.description: Optional weight for this item (positive numeric value stored as string). Weights do not need to sum to a specific total; normalization can be performed by the consuming application as needed.

itemIdentifier.description: Strong reference to an item in this collection. Items can be activities (org.hypercerts.claim.activity), features (org.hypercerts.entity.feature), and/or other collections (org.hypercerts.collection).

item.description: An item in a collection, with an identifier and optional weight.

tags.description: References to org.hypercerts.vocab.tag records classifying this record. All listed tags apply simultaneously (logical AND); the array carries no ordering, weighting, negation, inheritance, or rule logic, and never will — any future expression logic must arrive as a new field and must never reinterpret this one.

type.description: The type of this collection. Values beyond the known set are permitted.

items.description: Array of items in this collection with optional weights.

langs.description: Human language(s) of this record's text fields, as BCP-47 language tags (e.g. 'es', 'pt-BR'); up to three for mixed-language text. Set by the writing app from the text the author wrote, with the author able to correct it; never from the interface language or a profile preference alone. A hint for readers, not a guarantee: consumers must not hide a record because it lacks this field.

title.description: Display name for this collection (e.g. 'Q1 2025 Impact Projects')

avatar.description: The collection's avatar/profile image as a URI or image blob.

banner.description: Larger horizontal image to display behind the collection view.

location.description: A strong reference to the location where this collection's activities were performed. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon app.certified.location.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.

description.description: Long-form description of the collection. An inline string for plain text or markdown, a Leaflet linear document for rich-text content, or a strong reference to an external description record.

shortDescription.description: Short summary of this collection, suitable for previews and list views. Rich text annotations may be provided via `shortDescriptionFacets`.

shortDescriptionFacets.description: Rich text annotations for `shortDescription` (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc).

main.description: A collection/group of items (activities and/or other collections). Collections support recursive nesting.
